name: genie3_design
description: Design protein backbones with Genie 3. Either give a 'length' to sample unconditional backbones of that size, or a 'target' from the shipped binder-design benchmark to design binders against it. Returns a per-design record; the PDB text itself is opt-in.

length.description: Backbone length for unconditional design: '100', or a range '100-200' sampled in steps. 10-670.

length_step.description: Step between lengths when 'length' is a range (default: the whole range in one step, i.e. one length). n_designs backbones are sampled at EACH length.

target.description: Binder-design target from the pinned checkout's benchmark: 01_bhrf1, 02_sc2rbd, 03_il7ra, 04_pdl1, 05_trka, 06_insulinr, 07_h1, 08_vegfa, 09_il17a, 10_tnfa.

n_designs.description: Backbones per length or per target (default 1, max 8).

n_steps.description: DDIM sampling steps (default 100, upstream's own; max 200). Fewer is faster and lower quality.

batch_size.description: Designs per denoiser call (default 1, max 2). Higher is faster per design and costs proportionally more VRAM; the kit refuses a batch that does not fit by name, before it runs.

seed.description: Random seed; the same seed reproduces the designs.

return_structures.description: Return the PDB text of every backbone (default false).
